summary: Remediated PR-179 is ready for its registered closeout. All 21 assigned inputs match their registered hashes; the exact 19,999-draw producer check rebuilt all ten outputs byte-for-byte; the two registered test files pass 27/27; and independent recounts reproduce the one exceedance, plus-one rank 2/20000 = 0.0001, Clopper-Pearson interval, one-grid guard, null-score hash, H_cat coefficient map, all nine manifest-member hashes, and the manifest generation root. Every preserved code/statistics finding is concretely closed by current source, tests, and regenerated artifacts. The earlier claim review's scope defect is closed because this assignment covers all nine manifest members plus the manifest, and the complete-pack scan finds no affirmative physical, cosmological, geometry, family, transfer, native-solver, or HTT-inference promotion. The terminal is literally H_ONLY_SELECTION_SYSTEMATICS_CONDITIONAL; q_cat is withheld; the extreme H-only matched-null rank remains supporting selection/systematics-conditional catalogue evidence only.

Unreported cross-method covariance, catalogue calibration, method mix, missingness, selection, and sky-footprint leakage remain unauthenticated.

H_cat is a phenomenological catalogue-fit coefficient label. Its amplitude and axis do not measure a directional Hubble constant, prove anisotropy, identify a peculiar-flow cause, or establish/exclude geometry or family.
q_cat is withheld because the prospective response gate fails; no q value, axis, envelope, or rank may be reconstructed from design diagnostics.
